description.zh:
目标文件系统ID。

一次调用最多指定100个文件系统，当您需要取消多个文件系统的自动快照策略时，多个文件系统ID之间用半角逗号（,）隔开。
description.en:
The IDs of the file systems.

You can specify up to 100 file systems in a single call. To cancel the automatic snapshot policy for multiple file systems, separate the file system IDs with commas (,).

title.zh: 取消一个或者多个文件系统的自动快照策略
title.en: Cancel the automatic snapshot policy for one or more file systems
